input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII is entirely one-sided: only Licensor benefits from the exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and only Licensor's liability is capped — at one half of amounts paid, well below the walk-away floor of six months' fees. Licensee's liability is left uncapped and is expanded by the broad Article XII indemnity, with no carve-outs for confidentiality/data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement (indeed, (a) purports to exclude all Licensor liability for IP infringement). We made the exclusion and the cap mutual, reset the basis to the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, added the Excluded Claims carve-outs and confirmed Licensee's fee obligations are not capped damages.

proposal.summary: Make Article XIII exclusion and cap mutual, reset cap to greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, and add Excluded Claims carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the damages exclusion and the liability cap mutual and reset the cap to the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, as the current one-half-of-amounts-paid Licensor-only cap leaves us fully exposed while capping Licensor below any meaningful level. We have also placed indemnification, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and confirmed that our fee payment obligations are not limited by it; a mutual 12-month fee cap with at least indemnity, confidentiality and gross negligence/wilful misconduct carve-outs is our fallback.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE TO LICENSEE OR TO ANY THIRD PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (i) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (ii) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
